rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or organization that is among the earliest and most influential in a field.

example.english: This company is a pioneer in local electronic payments.
example.traditional: 呢間公司係本地電子支付嘅先驅。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 gung1 si1 hai6 bun2 dei6 din6 zi2 zi1 fu6 ge3 sin1 keoi1

rows.note: Use this colloquial metaphor for someone who opens up a new area or is among the first to work in a new field.

example.english: Our company is a pioneer in Hong Kong's esports industry.
example.traditional: 我哋公司係本地電競界嘅開荒牛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hai6 bun2 dei6 din6 ging6 gaai3 ge3 hoi1 fong1 ngau4

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone goes ahead and leads the way for others to follow.

example.english: Our manager is the pioneer leading the team into drone rescue.
example.traditional: 我哋經理係帶隊進軍無人機救援嘅開路先鋒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ging1 lei5 hai6 daai2 deoi6 zeon3 gwan1 mou4 jan4 gei1 gau3 wun4 ge3 hoi1 lou6 sin1 fung1
